note: 顶层站点上展示的 bench 清单。顺序即首页顺序。placeholders 是首页 Benchmarks 区为后续 bench 预留的空位数量。carousel 是首页榜单轮播最多几张：live 的 bench 先放，不够时用占位补齐。category 是总榜里的分类标签；version 是总榜和轮播读哪一版的榜；github 是这个 bench 自己的仓库，只在它的页面上出现。 launched 是上线月份（YYYY-MM），首页顶部的提示条显示最新上线的那个 bench 和它的月份。

benches.name: ResearchClaw Bench
benches.summary: 把一篇论文拆成任务包：题面、数据、相关工作都给智能体，答案藏在隐藏的评分清单里。公开 40 题覆盖 10 个学科，由方法线连成一张网。
benches.task_type: 任务包 · 开放域复现
benches.tasks_lede: 每道题来自一篇论文：题面、数据和相关工作公开，评分材料不在这个站上。
benches.board_lede: 按均分排名，每格颜色表示该学科的平均分。点一行展开分题成绩。
benches.private_note: 评分清单、目标论文和参考图不在这个站上。
benches.summary_en: Each task package comes from a real paper: statement, data and related work are given, the answers sit in a hidden scoring checklist. Forty public tasks across ten fields, linked into a network by shared methods.
benches.tasks_lede_en: Every task comes from a paper: statement, data and related work are public, scoring material is not on this site.
benches.board_lede_en: Ranked by mean score; cell colour is the domain mean. Open a row for per-task results.
benches.board_empty_en: No public submissions for this version yet.
benches.private_note_en: The scoring checklist, target paper and reference figures are not on this site.

benches.name: AgentFrontierExam 1.0
benches.tagline: 在最优解尚未明确的科学前沿，衡量真正的创新能力
benches.summary: Agent Frontier Exam 评测研究 Agent 能否面向真实、尚未解决的前沿科学问题，在开放的环境中自主调研，提出并验证改进方案，取得可衡量的进展，推进问题的边界。
benches.board_lede: 每个结果都相对于其他 Agent 和当前前沿进行衡量。
benches.private_note: Verifier 在运行前冻结，并在离线环境中评分。
benches.tagline_en: Measure true innovation at scientific frontiers where the optimum is still unknown.
benches.summary_en: Agent Frontier Exam evaluates whether research agents can independently investigate real, unresolved frontier problems in an open environment, propose and validate improvements, make measurable progress and advance the boundary of the problem.
benches.board_lede_en: Every result is measured against other agents and the current frontier.
benches.private_note_en: The verifier is frozen before a run and scores offline.
